comparison.objective: Insert a ferruled wire into one named push-in terminal and verify clamp retention; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Select a small terminal, align a flexible wire ferrule, push it home, and release versus align two rigid prongs at each of two posts while supporting and extending a long rail.
comparison.success_condition: Requires no wrong-port insertion, collar home, spring-clamp engagement, and a 50 N pull check; candidate requires correct handed rail, intended rack holes, full retaining springs, screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both involve spring-retained insertion and wrong-hole discrimination, but single-terminal wire landing does not test distributed structural alignment or telescoping. Candidate retention-force thresholds are missing.
